# Faith Haven House — Complete Organizational & AI Knowledge Base

> Faith Haven House is a 501(c)(3) non-profit transitional living facility dedicated to helping homeless single adult men in St. Charles County, Missouri rebuild their lives, secure stable employment, and transition to independent living.

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Mission Statement
- **Mission:** To provide safe, structured transitional housing, holistic life-skills support, spiritual grounding, and accountability to single adult men experiencing homelessness in St. Charles County.
- **Vision:** A community where every man who has fallen on hard times has a clear, dignified pathway to restoration, independence, and permanent housing.
- **Legal Status:** Certified 501(c)(3) tax-exempt public charity. All financial gifts and donations are tax-deductible.
- **Service Area:** St. Charles County, Missouri (including St. Charles, O'Fallon, St. Peters, Wentzville, Lake Saint Louis, and surrounding municipalities).

---

## 2. Program Model & Resident Requirements
- **Length of Stay:** Program average of 122 days. Extended based on case management goals and milestone progression.
- **Target Demographic:** Single adult men (aged 18+) facing homelessness, housing insecurity, or post-crisis transition.
- **Core Pillars:**
  1. **Shelter & Nutrition:** Safe accommodations, private storage, three daily meals, and basic hygienic necessities.
  2. **Case Management:** Custom recovery and housing stabilization plans developed with dedicated staff.
  3. **Employment & Stewardship:** Mandatory job search/retention assistance, financial literacy, and savings plans.
  4. **Accountability & Safety:** Zero-tolerance substance policy, random drug/alcohol screenings, daily curfews, and facility guidelines.
  5. **Spiritual Care & Mentorship:** Optional bible studies, peer mentoring, and connections to local faith communities.
- **Notice on Medical & Detox Services:** Faith Haven House is a transitional residential facility, not a licensed medical clinic, psychiatric unit, or clinical detoxification center. Candidates requiring active medical detox or high-level clinical psychiatric stabilization are referred to specialized regional health partners before admission.

---

## 3. Leadership & Governance
- **Founder:** Dareth Jeffers (1960–2024), whose vision and compassionate calling established Faith Haven House.
- **Executive Director:** Marshall Robinson ("Book"), bringing operational leadership and community outreach oversight.
- **Vice President, Board of Directors:** HJ Hohensee, local entrepreneur with personal lived experience of childhood homelessness.
- **Board Members & Key Staff:**
  - Tammy Conderman (Board Member)
  - Toni Lynch (Board Member & Community Advocate)
  - Mike Keller (Board Treasurer, financial and project management leader)

---

## 4. Admissions & How to Apply
- **Admissions Application:** Online pre-screening application available at `https://www.faithhavenhouse.org/admissions`.
- **Intake Steps:**
  1. Submit online pre-screening form or call `(636) 387-1755`.
  2. Complete initial phone interview with admissions staff.
  3. Review background check acknowledgment and zero-tolerance policy.
  4. Scheduled intake appointment upon bed availability.

---

## 5. Funding & Community Support
- **Donation Platform:** Faith Haven House utilizes Zeffy for 100% fee-free online donations, ensuring 100% of donor funds directly support resident housing and operational care.
- **Donation Link:** `https://www.faithhavenhouse.org/about#donate`
- **Volunteering:** Meal prep, facility maintenance, mentoring, and professional skill-sharing opportunities available at `https://www.faithhavenhouse.org/volunteer`.
